extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent followed all compliance rules, including delivering the disclaimer before discussing benefits and collecting the Scope of Appointment before scheduling the appointment. The customer is interested in the lowest premium plan.
composition.coaching_note: Jordan did well by adhering to all compliance rules. However, it would be beneficial to ask more specific questions about the customer's needs to ensure the plan chosen best fits their requirements.
